body:
I see the problem. Take from props if the props are null in
componentWillReceiveProps. On initial mount take from the state if it
doesn't exist then try getting from the props? That might fix it
On Fri, Feb 10, 2017 at 19:03 Vincent Voyer <notifications@github.com>
wrote:

> It means that when reading from a url, then the configure parameters must
> be extracted and passed through the props.
>
> Do we have an example on how to do that?
>
> @zackify <https://github.com/zackify> what do you think? We believe it's
> tricky to have a Configure widget that read both ways (from props, from
> state).
>
> When it reads from both props and state, which one should take precedence?
> @mthuret <https://github.com/mthuret> Can you maybe precise exactly what
> were the struggles trying to support it both ways?
